stories.title: 'Did that really happen?' How the Red Sox went from 10-17 to the postseason
stories.summary: When Chad Tracy took over the Red Sox, they were in last place. Now, they're playoff-bound.

stories.title: Bears coach says QB Williams week-to-week, likely to miss time
stories.summary: Bears coach Ben Johnson said Monday on ESPN 1000 that quarterback Caleb Williams' right hamstring injury "sounds like it's going to be a week-to-week deal for him."

stories.title: Vikings QB Murray clears concussion protocol, will start vs. Bucs
stories.summary: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray has cleared the concussion protocol and will start Sunday's game at the Buccaneers, coach Kevin O'Connell announced Monday.

stories.title: Gators coach on being fave vs. Ole Miss: 'Lot of good drugs out there'
stories.summary: First-year Florida coach Jon Sumrall was surprised to learn his 21st-ranked Gators are 3.5-point favorites when they host fourth-ranked Ole Miss on Saturday.

stories.title: Doc Rivers joins NBC as analyst, says coaching career over
stories.summary: Doc Rivers turned down an offer to become an NBA analyst for NBC after retiring as a player in 1996 because he couldn't promise then-NBC Sports chairman Dick Ebersol that he wouldn't become a coach.
